channel.title: The Melting Pod
channel.description: Stories about our dysfunctional immigration system and where we go from here.

item.title: Biden and the Border, Part 2
item.description: In the second half of our deep dive into the Biden administration’s border policy, we pick up in 2023 at the end of Title 42. We move past the punditry to examine the CBP One app, the political theater of migrant busing, and outline a five-point plan for building a system based on reality rather than fear.

item.title: Biden and the Border, Part 1
item.description: The Biden administration came in promising a more humane approach to the border. What happened next surprised everyone—including Biden’s own team. We break down how good intentions met harsh realities.

item.title: Welcome to The Melting Pod
item.description: Meet your hosts: three former federal officials who served four presidents across two decades. We introduce ourselves, explain why we’re doing this, and lay out what you can expect from the show.
